## Coming soon

A future Backgammon Simplified Match Predictor is planned to add:

- ER versus ER match predictions;
- OpenGammon profile comparisons;
- small tournament predictions;
- supporting match statistics.

These capabilities are planned and are not part of the current embedded dashboard below.  The current dashboard explores OpenGammon player performance and skill data.


The application may take a moment to start, particularly after a period of inactivity.
